segments.name: E-commerce (Shopee)
segments.description: Online marketplace and logistics platform where sellers in Southeast Asia, Latin America and other markets reach buyers and pay for advertising and transaction services.
segments.evidence: We monetize Shopee's marketplace model mainly by offering sellers paid advertising services, charging transaction-based fees, and charging for certain value-added services, including logistics and fulfillment.

segments.name: Digital Financial Services (Monee)
segments.description: Provides consumer and small-business credit, banking, e-wallet, payment processing, wealth and insurance services to users and merchants on the platform.
segments.evidence: We generate revenue from our digital financial services business primarily from earning interest and fees from our credit and banking businesses, fees from our e-wallet, payment processing and wealth services and fees and premiums from our insurance business.

segments.name: Digital Entertainment (Garena)
segments.description: Offers mobile and PC online games and promotes eSports, selling in-game items to players worldwide.
segments.evidence: Garena offers mobile and PC online games and develops mobile games for the global market.

revenueModel.text: Sellers and buyers on Shopee pay marketplace advertising, transaction and value-added fees; loan, banking, e-wallet and insurance customers pay interest and fees; game players buy in-game items.
revenueModel.evidence: We monetize Shopee's marketplace model mainly by offering sellers paid advertising services, charging transaction-based fees, and charging for certain value-added services, including logistics and fulfillment.
